articles.title: Makera Z1 Now Available for Global Pre-Order, Bringing Entry-Level CNC with Pro-Level Power
articles.description: MIDDLETOWN, Del., June 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Makera, a global leader in intelligent desktop CNC technology, announced that global pre-orders for the highly anticipated Makera Z1 Desktop CNC are now open on the official website on June 9. Following a record-shattering Kickstarter campaign in 2025 that raised over $10.24 million in just 45 days, crowdfunding orders have begun shipping steadily and in succession, Makera Z1 is now available to creators worldwide.
